summary: Tested 4 bug fixes from user video feedback. Found and FIXED CSS issue causing menu layout shift. All 4 bugs verified as fixed.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: CSS in _cards-nacre.css was overriding Tailwind's 'fixed' class with 'position: relative'. Added :not(.fixed) exclusions to preserve fixed positioning for dropdown menus.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 bugs from user video feedback are now fixed. CSS fix applied to _cards-nacre.css to prevent position:relative from overriding fixed positioning on dropdown menus.

bug_1_menu_layout_shift.description: Menu dropdown causes layout shift - fix with fixed positioning
bug_1_menu_layout_shift.details: CSS in _cards-nacre.css was setting position:relative on elements with rounded-2xl and bg-white classes, overriding Tailwind's fixed class. Added :not(.fixed) exclusions to CSS selectors.
bug_1_menu_layout_shift.before_fix: Menu dropdown had position:relative, causing 157px layout shift
bug_1_menu_layout_shift.after_fix: Menu dropdown has position:fixed, no layout shift (0-1px)

bug_2_homepage_fixed_height.description: HomePage must be fixed height (100dvh, overflow hidden) - no vertical scroll
bug_2_homepage_fixed_height.details: HomePage has style='height: 100dvh; overflow: hidden; overscroll-behavior-y: contain;' - verified in code and computed styles

bug_3_scanner_ia_moved.description: Move Scanner IA from food library to scanner category in pregnancy
bug_3_scanner_ia_moved.details: Scanner IA card is REMOVED from FoodLibraryPage (/library). Page shows '191 aliments référencés' without Scanner IA card.

bug_4_maternity_bag_crash.description: Restore maternity bag list (was crashing due to broken GlossyReflect)
bug_4_maternity_bag_crash.details: MaternityBagPage (/maternity-bag) loads correctly with Documents, Pour maman, Pour bébé sections. GlossyReflect = () => null fix working.

additional_tests.favorites_page: PASS - FavoritesPage (/favorites) loads without crash, GlossyReflect fix working
additional_tests.menu_close_outside: PASS - Menu closes when clicking outside

bug_1_menu_layout_shift.root_cause: CSS selector in /app/frontend/src/styles/glossy/_cards-nacre.css was targeting [class*='rounded-'][class*='bg-white'] and setting position:relative, which overrode Tailwind's 'fixed' class on the menu dropdown
reproduction_steps: 3. Observe TopBar elements shift down ~157px when menu opens
bug_1_menu_layout_shift.mitigation: Added :not(.fixed) exclusion to CSS selectors in _cards-nacre.css to preserve fixed positioning for dropdown menus
